spec.query: select action, rev, store from "nixos_rebuild" where $timeFilter and action != 'boot'
select action, rev, store from "nixos_rebuild" where $timeFilter and action = 'boot'
SELECT max("uptime") FROM "system" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(linear)
SELECT mean("usage_active") FROM "cpu" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "cpu"::tag fill(linear)
SELECT mean("used_percent") FROM "mem" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(linear)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_recv"), 1s) as Down, non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_sent"), 1s) as Up FROM "net" WHERE "interface" != 'lo' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(linear)
